alvo.foco: Fazer perguntas com Are you…? e responder com Yes, I am / No, I'm not
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar como a Alice: Are you…? e a responder com Yes, I am / No, I'm not.
falas: Oh dear! I'm late!
Wait! Are you in a hurry?
Yes, I am! Are you new here?

alvo.gramatica: Where are you from? · Where is he from?
alvo.foco: Where are you from? Where is he from? (India, Tibet, mountain, river, monk, road)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar de onde alguém é com Where are you from? e Where is he from?, na estrada de Kim e do monge.
falas: Hello! Where are you from?
I’m from Tibet. Where are you from?
I’m from India. I’m from this town.

alvo.foco: cumprimentos informais: Hey, What’s up?, Not much (hey, hi, buddy, friend, café, coffee)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a cumprimentar amigos de modo informal com Hey! What’s up? Not much.
falas: Hey, Ray! What’s up?
Hey, Zoe! Not much. And you?
Not much. How’s it going?

alvo.foco: números de 6 a 10 e dollars: six, seven, eight, nine, ten (six, seven, eight, nine, ten, dollars)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende os números de 6 a 10 e a dizer valores em dólares, como no caixa de uma loja.
falas: Excuse me, how much is this?
It is six dollars.
And this one?

alvo.foco: pedir a conta e dividir com Check, please! e Let’s split it (check, tip, cake, soda, pie, table)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a pedir a conta com Check, please! e a dividir com Let’s split it, depois de uma torta.
falas: Ana, that was a great pie!
Yes, and the cake was great, too.
Excuse me! Check, please!

alvo.gramatica: What time is it? · It’s + hora o’clock
alvo.foco: perguntar e dizer as horas com What time is it? It’s…o’clock (clock, morning, noon, afternoon, hour)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar as horas com What time is it? e a responder com It’s + hora, como o rato no relógio.
falas: Rob, look at the clock! What time is it?
It’s one o’clock. The mouse is up!
And now? What time is it?

alvo.foco: a e an com animais: I’m a pig, He’s an ox (pig, spider, barn, web, ox, owl)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende quando usar a e an ao dizer o que alguém é, no celeiro do porquinho Wilbur.
falas: Hello! I’m new here. I’m a pig.
Hi, Wilbur! I’m a spider. I’m Charlotte.
A spider? This is a big barn.

alvo.foco: We’re e They’re para falar de nós e deles (hen, duck, goose, fox, acorn, king)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dizer quem nós somos (We’re) e quem eles são (They’re), com a galinha Henny Penny e os amigos.
falas: Help! Something is on my head. We’re in danger!
We’re friends. Look, they’re acorns.
Acorns? We’re hens, not squirrels.

alvo.gramatica: us · them: with us, for them
alvo.foco: us e them depois de preposição: with us, for them (cat, bell, mice, plan, rope, kitchen)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende us e them depois de for e with, na reunião dos ratos da fábula Belling the Cat.
falas: The cat is bad for us.
I have a plan. A bell!
A bell on the cat? It’s good for us.

alvo.foco: lugares abertos e fechados: The bank isn’t open (bank, mall, hours, closed, parking, sidewalk)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a falar de lugares abertos e fechados: The bank isn’t open yet. It’s closed.
falas: Silver, the bank isn’t open yet.
What are the hours?
It opens at nine. It’s only eight.

alvo.gramatica: revisão: respostas curtas (Yes, I am · No, he isn’t)
alvo.foco: respostas curtas e parabéns: Yes, I am. No, it isn’t. Congratulations! (place, mountain, party, present, winner, balloon)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dar parabéns e a responder com frases curtas: Yes, I am. Yes, it is. No, it isn’t, com o pai e o filho do livro Oh, the Places You’ll Go!
falas: Congratulations, Kid! Are you happy?
Yes, I am. Is this my place?
Yes, it is. Are you ready?

alvo.foco: We are… e Let’s… no time de esportes (football, basketball, volleyball, stadium, gym, match)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a falar de um time com We are… e Let’s…, numa partida no ginásio, como o time do Coach e do Slugger.
falas: Sam, we are a team! Let’s play the match!
Great! Is it football or basketball?
It is basketball. We are in the gym.

alvo.gramatica: Where is the…? · Where are the…?
alvo.foco: Where is the…? e Where are the…? (stairs, room, lady, bed, shoes, goose)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar Where is the…? e Where are the…?, com o ganso que passeia pela casa da cantiga.
falas: Where are the stairs?
The stairs are there, upstairs.
Where is the room?

alvo.gramatica: wake up · get up · get dressed
alvo.foco: phrasal verbs da manhã: wake up, get up, get dressed (rooster, daylight, sunbeam, yawning, bedhead, wake-up call)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende os phrasal verbs da manhã (wake up, get up, get dressed) para contar como começa o seu dia.
falas: Ben, wake up! The rooster is singing!
Five more minutes... I’m beat.
Rise and shine! A sunbeam is in your room.

alvo.gramatica: My birthday is in… · I’m turning…
alvo.foco: My birthday is in… e I’m turning… (birthday, candles, cake, party, present, year)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a falar do aniversário e da idade com My birthday is in… e I’m turning…, com o menino que está quase fazendo seis anos.
falas: My birthday is in May.
I know! How old are you?
I’m five. I’m turning six.

alvo.foco: Perguntas com or: Is it heavy or light? (heavy, empty, loud, quiet, wet, dry)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar e escolher entre duas opções com or (Is it heavy or light?), descrevendo objetos.
falas: Mia, is the box heavy or light?
It is too heavy! Be careful.
Is the bag full or empty?

alvo.foco: Would you like…? e I’d like… para convidar e aceitar (picnic, camping, sunset, campfire, flashlight, trail)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a convidar com Would you like…? e a aceitar com I’d like…, planejando um fim de semana de acampamento.
falas: Lily, would you like to go camping this weekend?
Yes, I’d love to! Let’s go camping!
Would you like a picnic by the trail?

alvo.foco: superlativos curtos: the biggest, the tallest, the best (biggest, smallest, tallest, oldest, newest, best)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dizer quem ou o que é “o mais…” com the + -est (the biggest, the tallest) e the best, numa competição.
falas: Kim, who is the winner? Who is the best?
The black horse is the biggest. It’s the best!
And the smallest? The white one?

alvo.foco: falar de hábitos com usually, always e sometimes: I usually wake up early (routine, usually, always, sometimes, early, schedule)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a falar de hábitos com usually, always e sometimes e vê a diferença entre I e he/she.
alvo.obra_atual: Yawar Fiesta de José María Arguedas
falas: The sky is clear today. What’s your routine, Luis?
I usually wake up early. I take the bus at seven.
Do you always have lunch at school?

alvo.foco: negar com doesn’t: The moon doesn’t sleep (balloon, cloud, moon, star, rainbow, breeze)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a negar com doesn’t + verbo: The moon doesn’t sleep. A star doesn’t move.
falas: Look at the sky, Russell.
The balloon doesn’t fall, Carl.
No, it doesn’t. It goes up.
